decisions: Collect each direct binding literal using canonical literal storage syntax; fixed payloads bypass readonly-use admission, dynamic/dictionary payloads require immutable whole-scope admission.
Use the last containing source unit for payload lifetime; mutable heap owners instead own a 24-byte header through the end of their source scope and have no automatic lifetime end.
Preserve per-function frame ownership and the existing allocator stable start ordering, inclusive overlap, cheapest slot growth, 4096-byte budget, and original lifetime sizes.
Async functions produce no stack frame; inline frame merge and final LLVM consumers are separate pending paths.
